name: Cursor Trail Hero
description: Full-screen dark hero where moving the cursor, dragging a finger or scrolling leaves a trail of images that pop in and out over big centered lettering, with six reveal styles.
contents: Full-screen gradient hero with large centered SVG lettering
Image trail spawned at the pointer
Touch instruction line shown on small screens
behavior: Images spawn along mouse movement, touch drag and page scroll, sized and rotated by pointer speed
Each image reveals and collapses with the chosen effect, then is removed after its lifespan
Images cycle through the image list in order
Mobile thresholds and image sizes are used under 768px or on mobile user agents

props.name: touchInstructionText
props.default: Swipe your finger to see the magic unfold

editableByProps: Images, background gradient, lettering color, touch hint text and mono font name
Trail timing, spacing, sizes, rotation and stagger

needsCodeEdit.where: the five svg path elements inside the section filled with letterColor
the config object inEasing, outEasing and easing entries

needsCodeEdit.change: Change fragment layouts of an effect

fixed: Centered lettering is hardcoded SVG paths
Film grain overlay is a fixed full-viewport SVG at z-index 9999 with pointer events disabled
Listens on document and window for mouse, touch and scroll, all removed on unmount
Loads the JetBrains Mono Google font through link tags
Root is h-screen and full width, override with className
Mobile mode is chosen once at mount from user agent or width up to 768px

options.look: Whole images scale in with a random tilt and spin out when removed
options.useWhen: Playful photographer or creative portfolio landing page

options.look: Image opens as horizontal blind strips flipping from the center
options.useWhen: Fashion or interiors hero wanting a sleek shutter reveal

options.look: Image opens as vertical strips parting from their centers
options.useWhen: Theatre, events or film landing page

options.look: Image appears through a cluster of growing hexagon shapes
options.useWhen: Tech or product studio hero with a geometric feel

options.look: Image blooms from several expanding circles like droplets
options.useWhen: Beauty, wellness or art brand hero with an organic feel

options.look: Image pops open from a 3 by 3 grid of tiles expanding from the center
options.useWhen: Gallery or magazine intro with a punchy tiled reveal
